exec.purpose: Read the battery level and charging state
allowedArgs: out=$(/usr/bin/pmset -g batt 2>/dev/null); src=$(printf '%s\n' "$out" | /usr/bin/sed -n "s/^Now drawing from '\(.*\)'.*/\1/p" | /usr/bin/head -1 | /usr/bin/tr -cd 'A-Za-z '); line=$(printf '%s\n' "$out" | /usr/bin/grep -E '[0-9]+%;' | /usr/bin/head -1); pct=$(printf '%s' "$line" | /usr/bin/grep -Eo '[0-9]+%' | /usr/bin/head -1 | /usr/bin/tr -d '%'); [ -n "$pct" ] || pct=null; state=$(printf '%s' "$line" | /usr/bin/cut -s -d';' -f2 | /usr/bin/sed 's/^ *//;s/ *$//' | /usr/bin/tr -cd 'A-Za-z '); detail=$(printf '%s' "$line" | /usr/bin/cut -s -d';' -f3 | /usr/bin/sed 's/ *present:.*//;s/^ *//;s/ *$//' | /usr/bin/tr -cd 'A-Za-z0-9 :()'); time=$(printf '%s' "$detail" | /usr/bin/grep -Eo '[0-9]+:[0-9][0-9]' | /usr/bin/head -1); printf '{"pct":%s,"source":"%s","state":"%s","detail":"%s","time":"%s"}' "$pct" "$src" "$state" "$detail" "$time"

settings.title: Notify when the battery runs low
